headlines.title: Cognizant Technology Solutions Sees Possible AI Pricing Relief in 2027
headlines.summary: Cognizant Technology Solutions (NASDAQ:CTSH) could see relief from artificial intelligence-related pressure on its services business in 2027 as new AI-driven demand grows, though the outlook remains uncertain, Chief Financial Officer Jatin Dalal said at Bank of Montreal’s Tech Conference.

headlines.title: 3 Tech Dividend Stocks That Could Turn $300,000 Into $4,200 in Annual Income
headlines.summary: Tech stocks rarely get picked to replace a paycheck, yet three of them pay dividends backed by billions in free cash flow. One of the trio has not raised its payout since 2019, and the reason may surprise income seekers.

headlines.title: Cognizant Technology Solutions (CTSH) Could Be 7% Undervalued On Claude AI Expansion
headlines.summary: Cognizant Technology Solutions (CTSH) has moved to deepen its push into enterprise AI by dedicating more than 25,000 professionals to a new Claude Frontier Capability Group, paired with a managed services model for Claude-powered systems. Despite the Claude Frontier announcement grabbing headlines, Cognizant Technology Solutions shares tell a more mixed story. The 30 day share price return of 8.9% and 90 day gain of 9.6% point to improving momentum.

headlines.title: Will Claude AI Services Change Cognizant Stock Narrative
headlines.summary: Cognizant Technology Solutions has created a Claude Frontier Capability Group with more than 25,000 professionals focused on delivering and running Claude AI systems for enterprises through a managed services model that takes responsibility for operating production workloads.

headlines.title: Cognizant (CTSH) Stock Could Be 42% Undervalued On Fresh AI Services Expansion
headlines.summary: Cognizant Technology Solutions has been busy reshaping its business around AI, yet the share price is still down sharply this year, which puts the focus squarely on what its cash flows can justify. With the stock now around US$65.00, the question is how that market quote lines up against the cash the company is expected to generate over time. The share price has fallen about 20.

description: Cognizant Technology Solutions Corporation, a professional services company, provides consulting and technology, and outsourcing services in North America, Europe, and internationally. It operates through four segments: Financial Services; Health Sciences; Products and Resources; and Communications, Media and Technology. It provides services, such as artificial intelligence (AI) and other technology services and solutions, consulting, application development, systems integration, quality engineering and assurance, engineering research and development, application maintenance, infrastructure, security, and business process services and automation. It also offers AI-led automation, which includes advisory, and process and IT automation solutions designed to simplify and accelerate automation adoption; business process outsourcing services, which help deliver business outcomes including revenue growth, increased customer and employee satisfaction, and cost savings; and Cognizant Moment, a digital experience service that uses AI to reimagine customer experiences and engineer strategies aimed at driving growth. It develops, licenses, implements, and supports proprietary and third-party software products and platforms; and develops industry-specific products and services. It offers solution to healthcare providers and payers, life sciences companies, banking, capital markets, payments and insurance companies, manufacturers, automakers, retailers, consumer goods, travel and hospitality, communications, media and entertainment, education, information services, and technology companies; and businesses providing logistic, energy, and utility services. It has a strategic partnership with Uniphore Technologies Inc. for the development of AI solutions that combine small language models and AI agents. It holds a strategic partnership with Travelport to build intelligent travel retail for the AI era. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Teaneck, New Jersey.
